SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.
   D. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nakuru
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

3. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   C. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.

4. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   B. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.

5. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.
   B. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.
   C. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.
   C. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..
   C. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.
   C. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.

9. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

10. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Measure rainfall only

11. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.
   C. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.
   C. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.

13. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.
   B. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.

14. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing The School.
   B. Say The School never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat The School as rumours only.
   D. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.
   D. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.

16. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Industries in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Enterprise Project at School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Peace and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Child Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Democracy in school and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Community Leadership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain The County Governments in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Compass Direction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
